# Pitagorin

> Pitagorin is an iPhone and iPad math-learning app designed primarily for children ages 5–13. Teens and adults can also use it to refresh basic mathematics and keep mental-math skills active.

Official website: https://lorenzovillarroel90.github.io/Pitagorin-website/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/pitagorin/id6756659468
Languages: English, Spanish, German, French, and Italian.

Localized websites:
- Spanish: https://lorenzovillarroel90.github.io/Pitagorin-website/es/
- German: https://lorenzovillarroel90.github.io/Pitagorin-website/de/
- French: https://lorenzovillarroel90.github.io/Pitagorin-website/fr/
- Italian: https://lorenzovillarroel90.github.io/Pitagorin-website/it/

## What Pitagorin teaches

- Arithmetic: addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, fractions, decimals, percentages, powers, roots, and related operations.
- Times Tables: focused learning for tables 1 through 12; Pitagorin Pro adds Smart Review and a fluency sprint.
- Algebra: guided topics including foundations, equations, proportional thinking, linear relationships, systems, exponents, and functions.
- Mathematical reasoning: target-number and equation-balancing puzzles.

## How learning works

- Arithmetic games include Speed, Survival, Versus, and other short challenges.
- Learning Game provides untimed practice with visual hints and paper-method tutorials.
- Academy lets learners build an exam, choose topics and difficulty, save results, and revisit tutorial explanations.
- Progress features include personal bests, Times Tables mastery, challenge scores, and Academy history.

## Audience and availability

- Primary audience: children ages 5–13 and their families.
- Also suitable for: teens and adults refreshing everyday maths or practising mental calculation.
- Devices: iPhone and iPad.
- Requirements: iOS 18 or later; iPadOS 18 or later.
- Price: free to download with optional Pitagorin Pro in-app purchases.

## Privacy summary

- No account, name, or email address is required.
- Learning progress and optional handwritten-work photos are stored locally on the device.
- The free version may show occasional interstitial ads; Pro users do not see ads.
- Firebase Analytics measures limited aggregate product usage and excludes learning answers, scores, progress records, precise location, advertising IDs, and handwritten-work photos.
